blocks.rationale: Jointly adds two narrowly scoped, native-type-safe helpers for all three trigger failures: a §3306(c)(5) family-employment classifier and an airline baggage calculator using atomic route/cabin fee fields instead of the previously unresolved derived fee arrays. Their output types and intents are distinct from the installed history skills, limiting interference with preserved parents.

inputs.name: employee_is_employed_by_own_child_or_spouse
inputs.question: Do the current facts establish that the employee performs the service in the employ of the employee's own son, daughter, or spouse?

skill.intent: Determine whether the current proposition correctly asserts that §3306(c)(5) applies because the employee works for the employee's own son, daughter, or spouse.

outputs.description: The current native binary label: Entailment when the expressly queried family-employment exclusion applies, otherwise Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Use at most one qualifying personal-item allowance and one qualifying carry-on allowance; treat every remaining item as a checked bag.

origin.quote:
1st and 2nd checked bags are complimentary for:
* AAdvantage Platinum® status
* oneworld® Sapphire members
* Confirmed Domestic First customers
* Confirmed Business customers
* Confirmed Premium Economy customers

source_obligations.statement: Apply the current route and cabin's first, second, third, and fourth-plus checked-bag fees, using zero for complimentary positions.

origin.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

source_obligations.statement: Calculate each checked bag's size by adding its outside length, width, and height.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag exceeds both weight and size standards, add only the higher excess charge to its checked-position fee.

source_provenance.quote: Your personal item like a purse or small handbag must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions should not exceed 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
To or from India, China, Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Australia and New Zealand
More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
